verdict.rationale: Kling's docs explicitly list text-to-video as a core capability, with priced Text to Video tiers. For iteration, the vendor describes refining and editing videos over multiple rounds, a node canvas that keeps creative context, video-input generation, and producing multiple versions at once to compare styles. missing for 10: concrete documentation of how a specific generated video clip is edited or extended in place (mask-based re-editing is documented only for images), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the iteration workflow.
